messages:
Sam P: quick ping — can someone take a look at PR #2148? It's the quant/kernel routing change + cache TTL tweak. worried about p99 and cost. https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2148
Maria G: can you paste the perf numbers briefly? rough before/after is fine.
Sam P: sure. microbench on g4dn with seq=512, batch=8:
```
before: p50 42ms, p95 110ms, p99 180ms, tokens/sec 720
after:  p50 40ms, p95 115ms, p99 205ms, tokens/sec 740
cost/unit: ~ -1.8% cpu time but p99 +25ms
```
Sam P: looks like small throughput gain but p99 regression at longer tails. cache TTL reduced from 120s -> 30s in this PR (helps mem pressure) — might explain tail.
Chen W: is the p99 regression from kernel routing change or from TTL eviction? can you run profile with kv-hit vs kv-miss split?
Sam P: good call. quick split:
```
kv-hit p99: 160ms
kv-miss p99: 320ms
```
Sam P: kv-miss is the big one; routing now favours cheaper kernel which has higher cold miss cost.
Chen W: hmm. alternative: keep TTL=120s but add adaptive eviction when mem>85%? that keeps hit rate for steady traffic while preventing OOM spikes.
Jonah L: also be mindful of Dedicated customers with strict 100ms p99 SLA on short seqs — we should gate rollout with a canary flag.
Tess R: +1 on canary. Also need an entry in console release notes about cache TTL change so support can triage.
CI Bot: build #2148 completed — unit tests passed, perf comparison job queued.
Maria G: I can take a look now. checking the routed kernel code...
Chen W: left one comment about the eviction threshold logic. small nit, but might change behavior under burst traffic.
Sam P: pushed a fix for the threshold and added a canary flag (env: ROUTING_CANARY=on). updated PR with canary instructions.
Maria G: re-reviewed, looks fine. please add a short perf test in perf CI for kv-miss path — just to prevent accidental regressions.
Sam P: added perf test. CI Bot: perf job for PR #2148 finished: regression within noise on steady load; kv-miss test shows +20ms p99 — flagged for attention.
Jonah L: ok plan: merge to main behind canary flag, enable for 5% traffic for 24h, monitor p99/alloc. If no regression, 25% -> 100% over 48h.
Tess R: i'll draft support note. anyone object to merging behind canary in the next merge window (in 1h)?
Chen W: no objections from me.
Maria G: all good.
Sam P: thanks all. will merge in ~1h unless more issues.
Tess R: :thumbsup:
Sam P: (will watch dashboards after canary goes live)
